correctness.rationale: The uniform post-vaccine seed normalization is exact: (n-1)Q_v equals E[sum |C|^2]. For n<=4, residual graphs have <=3 vertices, are totally ordered by edge count up to isomorphism, and have monotone percolation component-size scores; maximum original degree minimizes residual edges. For the 5-node connected diamond-plus-leaf witness, exact triangle-plus-isolate and four-path computations give Q_b-Q_d=p^2(1-4p)/2 and Q_d=Q_e. Vaccinations at a and c leave proper spanning supergraphs of P4 and are strictly worse for 0<p<1. Exact source verifier enumerates all 75 labelled lower-order graphs and all bond states of the witness; its resulting integer polynomials match each proof formula. No assertion rests on finite point sampling.

value.rationale: This is a motivated exact minimal-network obstruction to a parameter-independent single-vaccine choice under the common bond-percolation outbreak objective. It identifies when degree-only choices cease to resolve ties, and gives an exact transmission boundary at the smallest possible connected order. The structural cutoff is meaningful despite its small size, and has transparent limitations; it does not claim empirical effect size or a large-network generalization.
